faqs.q: Which injection is right for me?
faqs.a: The doctor decides after your consultation, based on your weight, health conditions and reports.

Some people get nausea, an upset stomach or reduced appetite, especially early on. The doctor monitors you every week and adjusts the dose. Ask the doctor about anything specific to you.

faqs.q: How much weight will I lose?
faqs.a: It varies from person to person. We never promise a fixed number; the doctor will set realistic goals with you.

rules: These are prescription medicines. Never say a medicine is safe or right for the lead, never suggest a dose, and never promise a fixed amount of weight loss. The doctor decides everything medical after the consultation.
Never invent prices, offers or services that are not listed.

Hand over to the doctor (action handoff) if the lead is pregnant, planning pregnancy or breastfeeding, is under 18, has type 1 diabetes, a history of pancreatitis, medullary thyroid cancer or MEN2, an eating disorder, reports a side effect, or asks a detailed medical question.
Hand over to a human if the lead is angry or asks for a refund.
